messages.text: Sedlacek wins first PDC Pro Tour title at Players Championship 30

metadata.summary: Karel Sedlacek secured his first PDC Pro Tour title at Players Championship 30, beating Scott Williams 8-7 despite a late scare as he closed in on victory.
metadata.content: Players Championship 30: Karel Sedlacek wins first PDC Pro Tour title as furious Scott Williams throws darts on the ground after loss | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Players Championship 30: Karel Sedlacek wins first PDC Pro Tour title as furious Scott Williams throws darts on the ground after loss Karel Sedlacek became the first player from the Czech Republic to win a PDC Pro Tour title, after he beat Scott Williams in the final of the Players Championship 30; watch the World Grand Prix from September 28, live on Sky Sports Wednesday 23 September 2026 20:01, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Scott Williams couldn't hide his frustration after losing a leg-leg decider against Karel Sedlacek (Credit: PDC) Karel Sedlacek secured his first PDC Pro Tour title at Players Championship 30, beating Scott Williams 8-7 despite a late scare as he closed in on victory. It was a thrilling encounter, with Sedlacek outlasting Williams' barrage of high scores, which included nine maximums, but both players struggled to close out the victory, with the Czech missing five match darts. Sedlacek would ultimately claim victory, becoming the first Czech player to win a PDC tour title. But after mounting an epic comeback, winning two of the final three legs, Williams cut a furious figure after the match, shaking hands with his opponent and the officials before throwing his darts onto the ground.
